/interface lte apn set [ find default=yes ] ip-type=ipv4 use-network-apn=no
/interface wireless security-profiles set [ find default=yes ] supplicant-identity=MikroTik
/ip smb users set [ find default=yes ] disabled=yes
/port set 0 name=serial0
/system logging action set 3 remote=172.18.84.101
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge ingress-filtering=no interface=ether1 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge edge=yes interface=ether2-yew-ptp-core-60 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge ingress-filtering=no interface=ether3 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether4 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge ingress-filtering=no interface=ether5 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge ingress-filtering=no interface=ether6 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge ingress-filtering=no interface=ether7 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge ingress-filtering=no interface=ether8 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge ingress-filtering=no interface=ether9 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge edge=yes frame-types=admit-only-vlan-tagged interface=ether10-yew-st-core-05 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge ingress-filtering=no interface=ether11 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge edge=yes interface=ether12-yew-ptp-basswood-05 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10 pvid=423
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge ingress-filtering=no interface=ether13 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge ingress-filtering=no interface=ether14 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge ingress-filtering=no interface=ether15 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge ingress-filtering=no interface=ether16 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=bond-yew-gw internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/ip firewall connection tracking set udp-timeout=10s
/ipv6 settings set disable-ipv6=yes max-neighbor-entries=8192
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge comment=mgmt tagged=bridge,bond-yew-gw,ether10-yew-st-core-05,ether12-yew-ptp-basswood-05 vlan-ids=104
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge comment=debug tagged=bond-yew-gw vlan-ids=99
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge comment=peer-basswood-05 tagged=bond-yew-gw vlan-ids=423
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge comment=peer-core-05 tagged=bond-yew-gw,ether10-yew-st-core-05 vlan-ids=203,204
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge comment=peer-core-60 tagged=bond-yew-gw,ether2-yew-ptp-core-60 vlan-ids=213,214
/interface ethernet switch rule add copy-to-cpu=yes disabled=yes ports=ether10-yew-st-core-05 switch=switch1
/interface ovpn-server server add auth=sha1,md5 mac-address=02:3B:5A:00:7E:50 name=ovpn-server1
/ip address add address=172.26.4.67/27 interface=bridge network=172.26.4.64
/ip dhcp-client add interface=vlan104-mgmt
/ip dns set servers=192.0.2.8,198.18.11.4
/ip ipsec profile set [ find default=yes ] dpd-interval=2m dpd-maximum-failures=5
/ip smb shares set [ find default=yes ] directory=/flash/pub
/ip ssh set always-allow-password-login=yes forwarding-enabled=both
/routing bfd configuration add disabled=no
/system clock set time-zone-autodetect=no time-zone-name=US/Pacific
/system identity set name=yew-sw-tower
/system logging set 0 topics=info,!account
/system logging add action=remote topics=info
/system logging add action=remote topics=warning
/system logging add action=remote topics=error
/system logging add action=disk topics=info,!account
/system logging add action=disk topics=warning
/system logging add action=disk topics=error
/system ntp client set enabled=yes
/system ntp client servers add address=pool.ntp.org
/system package update set channel=long-term
/system routerboard settings set auto-upgrade=yes
/system scheduler add name=auto-upgrade on-event=":local copyright \"\A9 2021 Stuart Schneider, all rights reserved\";\r\
    \n\r\
    \n:delay 1500ms;\r\
    \n:log info \"auto-upgrade: Checking for firmware upgrade\";\r\
    \n:local current [/system routerboard get current-firmware];\r\
    \n:local upgrade [/system routerboard get upgrade-firmware];\r\
    \n:if (\$current!=\$upgrade) do={\r\
    \n        :log info \"auto-upgrade: Firmware upgrade needed (from \$current to \$upgrade), applying\";\r\
    \n        /system routerboard upgrade\r\
    \n        :delay 3500ms;\r\
    \n        :log info \"auto-upgrade: Rebooting to apply firmware upgrade\";\r\
    \n        /system reboot\r\
    \n} else={\r\
    \n        :log info \"auto-upgrade: Firmware is up to date (version \$current)\";\r\
    \n}\r\
    \n" policy=ftp,reboot,read,write,policy,test,password,sniff,sensitive,romon start-time=startup
/tool bandwidth-server set authenticate=no
/tool romon set enabled=yes
/tool sniffer set file-name=pcap.pcap filter-interface=ether12-yew-ptp-basswood-05 filter-stream=yes streaming-server=172.31.174.47
